controlled_change: Training data, deterministic augmentation, branch probabilities, optimizer, model, seeds, maximum epochs and patience remain identical to V2. The only controlled change is checkpoint selection: after the clean guardrail, prioritize the worst of three frozen -5 dB validation repeats instead of clean validation loss.
checkpoint_selection_order: maximize minimum -5 dB recording Macro-F1 across the three frozen repeat seeds
maximize mean -5 dB recording Macro-F1 across the repeats
comparison: Exactly paired against V2 on all 40 previously frozen known-validation stress conditions, three model seeds and the unchanged probability ensemble.

acceptance.clean_guardrail: candidate three-seed mean clean recording Macro-F1 must be at least V2 minus 0.03
acceptance.minus5_primary_mean: candidate single-model mean across the three -5 dB repeats and three seeds must exceed V2
acceptance.minus5_primary_worst_case: candidate worst seed-repeat -5 dB recording Macro-F1 must strictly exceed the V2 worst seed-repeat
acceptance.zero_to5_guardrail: candidate single-model 0/5 dB mean must be at least V2 minus 0.03
acceptance.multipath_guardrail: candidate single-model multipath mean must be at least V2 minus 0.03
